_doc: Single source of every assumption number. The build copies `pricing`, `graded`, `simulation` and `chase` into public/data/index.json -> meta.assumptions so the UI starts from the same defaults (users may override them in their browser).

pricing._doc: Raw (ungraded NM) valuation. Cards priced below bulkThreshold are valued at bulkRatePerCard instead of market. Net = price*(1-sellFeePct) - perCardShipping, applied only to cards at/above the threshold.
pricing._bulkRateByGroupNote: Optional per-group bulk rates. Keys are tier names (e.g. 'Double Rare') or filler pool ids ('common', 'uncommon', 'rare', 'reverse'). Unlisted groups use bulkRatePerCard.
pricing._sellFeeSource: TCGplayer Marketplace Level 1-4 seller: 10.75% commission (raised from 10.25% on 2026-02-10) + 2.5% payment processing. The $0.30/order processing fee is folded into perCardShipping. https://help.tcgplayer.com/hc/en-us/articles/23315007565079
pricing._perCardShippingNote: Seller's cost to ship one single (stamp + envelope + toploader + $0.30 order fee). Ignores shipping charged to the buyer.
pricing._netFloorNote: If true, a card just above the threshold never nets less than the bulk rate (a rational seller would bulk it instead). Off by default to match the spec's literal formula.
pricing._priceFallbackNote: Market price only. When a card's TCGplayer marketPrice is null it is treated as unpriced; a set with any unpriced hit-tier card has its EV withheld (unpriced filler cards count at the bulk rate). ('low'/'mid' would substitute TCGplayer's lowest/median listing, which is not a market price.)

graded._doc: Graded EV is opt-in in the UI and never the default. gemRate and gradingCost are user sliders labeled as assumptions.

chase._doc: Tiers counted for the 'chase odds' metric, per pack layout. Only tiers with known odds in a set are included; the label lists the ones actually used.

fx._doc: USD->CAD is fetched once per build from the Bank of Canada Valet API (official, keyless). If that fails the previous build's rate is reused, then this fallback.

tcgcsv._userAgentNote: In GitHub Actions the build appends +https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> so tcgcsv can see who is calling.

validation._doc: Hard failures stop the publish. EV swings only warn.
